segments.title: Cold Open & Technical Difficulties
segments.notes: Case and Pepito struggle through three stream restart attempts; Pepito admits to biting power cords and delivers a one-word prayer.

segments.title: Trump Fires Labor Official, Fed Governor Resigns, Tariff Fallout
segments.notes: Case and new correspondent Girf cover Trump firing BLS commissioner Erica Mick and Taffer over weak jobs data, Fed governor Adriana Kugler's surprise resignation, S&P 500 dropping 1.6%, and Kamala Harris on Colbert declaring the system broken.

segments.title: Armpit Odor Study & Pasta Bowl vs Plate Debate
segments.notes: Chet triggers on 'science' to present Japanese study on women's armpit odor affecting male attraction; Devil possesses Chet, then Munch and Crum debate pasta vessel superiority while Devil awards Munch a key for the wall.

segments.title: Video Review: Fire Eater, Tom Green, Video Store, Fossils, Animal Clips
segments.notes: Peter Gibbon joins from the walls; Case and Peter watch fire-eating woman, Tom Green katana training, Minneapolis video store 'Nicolet Village Video', fossil hunting with rock hammer, and animal videos including Hulk Hogan tribute.

segments.title: AI Rooney: Hot Dog/Bun Mismatch, Salsa Semantics, Skirt Airflow
segments.notes: Rare segment activation; AI-generated Andy Rooney rants about hot dog packs of ten vs bun packs of eight, salsa meaning sauce, skirts being too airy, and LAN parties.

segments.title: Song Production: 'Smooth Like Mayo' Parody with Mancini Smooth
segments.notes: Case, ghostwriter, and chat write Maroon 5 'Moves Like Jagger' parody about mayonnaise; Mancini Smooth records vocals in multiple takes; Jay Drilla (Jev) performs bridge; Case announces vacation next week.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchored Friday News Blast through technical difficulties, news desk, science interruption, video review, AI Rooney, and a marathon mayonnaise parody song production.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Claimed responsibility for biting power cords and breaking the stream three times; delivered a one-word prayer ('Amen').

characters.name: Girf
characters.notes: Debuted as a wandering, youthful-appearing correspondent who debates Case on astral projection, height, and government trust while co-anchoring the news desk.

characters.name: Chet (Chet Manscape)
characters.notes: science correspondent. Triggered by the word 'science' to present a Japanese study on women's armpit odor compounds spiking at ovulation and increasing male attraction.

characters.name: The Devil
characters.notes: supernatural entity. Auto-possessed Chet, bantered with Munch and Crum about Crum's missing penis, awarded Munch a key for the wall expedition, then departed.

characters.name: Munch (Ralph Munchcut)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Defended plates over bowls in pasta debate, won 8-0, received a key from the Devil for the wall thing, and mocked Crum's missing penis.

characters.name: Crum (Leonard Crum)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Argued for bowls, complained about missing penis after gorilla punch, let Devil speak for him, and threatened revenge on Gorilla, DJ, and Munch.

characters.name: Peter Gibbon
characters.notes: news stowaway. Emerged from walls to join video review, made racist adjacent joke about video store name, refused to leave, and claimed infinite space between walls.

characters.name: Mancini Smooth
characters.notes: musical guest. Returned after absence to record 'Smooth Like Mayo' vocals in multiple takes, claimed production as first love, and left before bridge.

characters.name: Jay Drilla (Jev)
characters.notes: musical guest. Recorded bridge vocals for mayo parody after warming up with 'Unique New York'; departed immediately after.

characters.name: Ghostwriter
characters.notes: ghost writer. Assisted lyric writing for mayo parody as a literal ghost who imagines his voice onto the mortal plane.

storylines.beat: [36:07] Devil and Munch reference Crum's missing penis from the gorilla punch; Munch claims he couldn't find it during resurrection.
[47:02] Devil gives Munch a key to 'use at the end of the wall thing' and says Munch must go on a 'Perseus style expedition' to retrieve Crum.

lore_notes.fact: [05:18] Debuts as a wandering correspondent who claims to be younger than Case in years but older in spirit; has a brother who also wanders.
[01:10:19] Announces vacation next week (no stream); will return Monday after next; may attempt 'dumb stream' from laptop if friends allow.
[02:11:15] Returns after extended absence; claims he has 'grown past' and 'evolved beyond' the network but returns to roots; wears same tuxedo from first appearance.
[02:25:08] Current nickname is 'Jev'; performs bridge vocals for mayo parody; warming routine is repeating 'Unique New York'.
[47:02] Gives Munch a physical key for the wall expedition; claims Munch must undertake the journey himself.

episode_summary: Barely Informed News overcame a three-restart cold open to deliver a packed Friday News Blast: Trump's firing of the BLS commissioner and a Fed governor's resignation rattled markets, new correspondent Girf made a chaotic desk debut, Chet's science segment on armpit pheromones summoned the Devil, who awarded Munch a key for the wall expedition after Munch crushed Crum 8-0 in the pasta bowl-vs-plate debate. Peter Gibbon emerged from the walls for a video review block, AI Rooney returned for a rare cantankerous monologue, and the broadcast closed with a marathon live songwriting session producing the mayonnaise-themed 'Smooth Like Mayo' featuring Mancini Smooth and Jay Drilla. Case announced a one-week vacation hiatus.
